generatedProse.practice-connection:
Everything in this course applies to the exams and revision you are already doing. Every subject you study sets assessments, and the students who revise actively and control the exam day are the ones whose results reflect what they actually know. Treat what follows as being about your own exams and revision, not about study in the abstract.

The same demand reaches beyond exams. Wherever you prepare for something that matters and perform under pressure, the same habit pays off. Working with what you know, rather than merely reviewing it, is a discipline you keep long after you graduate.
